title: OAuth2 token issued by API Connect rejected by backend microservice
description: After configuring OAuth2 authorization on the Payments API in API Connect, the token issued by APIC is being rejected by the payments microservice with a 401 Invalid Token error. The same token is accepted when tested directly against the APIC token validation endpoint.

worklogs.description: Decoded the JWT token. Found the iss (issuer) claim value does not match what the payments microservice expects.
Microservice is configured to validate tokens from 'https://api.corp.local/payments' but APIC is issuing tokens with issuer 'https://apic-gw.corp.local/corp/prod'.
Updated payments microservice JWT validator to accept the APIC issuer URL.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I decoded the JWT token that APIC is issuing and compared it to what the payments microservice expects. The token is valid and correctly signed, but the issuer claim (iss) in the token is set to 'https://apic-gw.corp.local/corp/prod' - this is the APIC gateway's standard issuer format. The payments microservice is configured to only accept tokens from 'https://api.corp.local/payments' which was the old self-issued token setup. The microservice's JWT validator needs to be updated to...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Yes, please coordinate with Serhat Demirci - he owns the payments microservice.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Serhat has updated the JWT validator configuration. The payments microservice now accepts tokens from the APIC issuer. I have run a full OAuth2 flow test - the token is now accepted and the API call succeeds with a 200 response. Could you run a test from your application to confirm?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Tested - the payments flow is working end to end. Thank you.

resolutionNote: The payments microservice JWT validator was configured to accept tokens from the old self-issued token issuer URL, not the API Connect gateway issuer URL. Updated the microservice JWT validator to accept the APIC issuer.

csat.comment: Clear diagnosis and worked well with our microservice team to get it fixed quickly.
